----- EXEC [dbo].[sp_ins_Catalyst_TradeDistinct]

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #DISTINCTTRADES;

WITH CTE AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY catalyst_trade_number, [effective_date] ORDER BY catalyst_trade_number) RN,
		 [effective_date], [catalyst_fists],[catalyst_fists_distribution], [catalyst_trade_number], [fists_trade_number]

		,[contract_month] ,[contract_year], [call_put],[strike_price] ,[factor] ,[coupon_rate] ,[transmit_to_back_office]
		,[group_link] ,[is_sales_credit] ,[ticker] ,[back_office_status] ,[back_office_statusreason] ,[ext_counterparty_id]

		,[to_trader_id] ,[sales_person_id] ,[position_update_time] ,[account_role] ,[FileName] ,[LoadDate]
		,[CancelType] ,[entered_by] ,[entered_by_id] ,[cancelled_by] ,[cancelled_by_id] ,[approved_by] ,[approved_by_id] 
		,[updated_by] ,[updated_by_id] ,[trace_MPID] ,[submit_time] ,[trace_ctrl_no] ,[trace_orig_ctrl_no] ,[trace_status_string]
		,[trace_last_updated_by] ,[customer_long_name] ,[override_MPID] ,[salesperson] ,[currency] ,[linkTypeCode] ,[SalesCreditCode] ,[SalesCredit]
        ,[account_type] ,[customer_type] ,[venueTradeId] ,[micCode] ,[legType] ,[legal_entity] ,[msrb_special_code] ,[originatingSystemID]
		,[SMMPIndicator] ,[allocationMatchStatus] ,[allocationMatchStatusReason], [action]
   FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_Trade]
   WHERE catalyst_trade_number IS NOT NULL
   and trade_status = 'ACTIVE'
   and [trade_state] NOT LIKE '%PENDING%'
   and cast([entry_time] as date) >= getdate()-7
		   )

--- EXEC dbo.sp_upd_CatalystTrade_CancelType


UPDATE T
SET T.CancelType =   'CXLCOR'
FROM [Reconcontrol].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct] T
	WHERE trade_status = 'CNCL'
		AND prev_trade_number IS NOT NULL
		  AND   ([catalyst_trade_number] <> '' 
			OR    [catalyst_trade_number] > 0 )--)
		  AND T.CancelType IS  NULL


UPDATE T
SET T.CancelType =   'STRCXL'
FROM [Reconcontrol].[dbo].[tbl_Catalyst_TradeDistinct] T
	WHERE trade_status = 'CNCL'
		and prev_trade_number is null
		  AND T.CancelType IS NULL
